actual_checks: Full exact report, literal prompt, all provenance/source records and both retained full prior scientific contributions read, including the newer unaudited individual OpenAI claim. This is a published six-beta benchmark plus explicit arithmetic/elimination analysis, distinct from prior one-variable approximants and claim-summary status.

Zudilin Theorem 1 has precisely beta(2),...,beta(12), whereas the simpler Section 2 yields eight values. Section 3 uses s=13 and eta=(31,10,10,10,10,10,11,11,11,11,12,12,12,12), with even n since eta_0 is odd, M=11n. Positivity, odd-index symmetry elimination and Lemma 5 coefficient integrality, including the constant coefficient, are matched exactly.

Multiplying the coefficient inclusion by d_M^i makes every coefficient of the normalized form integral. If all six beta values were rational, a single common denominator Q would make the positive normalized forms positive integers tending to zero, impossible. The source decay/growth strict margin is an imported published assertion, not independently certified numerical optimization.

An invertible five-by-five unwanted-column matrix has trivial left kernel, so five available rows cannot eliminate all five unwanted values. Six rows supply a left-kernel vector but do not guarantee survival of Catalan coefficient, actual nonvanishing or preserved height/decay. The report identifies each additional requirement and does not promote the six-value disjunction to individual irrationality or independently verify newer Lean/manuscript claims.
